Receive PO; Add line; leave lot/serial number blank; enter done quantity; Quantity Done updates / Confirm

items.title: [20.0][MIG] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: Migration to 20.0
items.body:
Migrates stock_picking_auto_create_lot to 20.0, keeping the module history.

The product form shows the tracking choice through store_by in 20.0, so the auto create lot field is added after it. tracking has no "none" value any more (False means tracked by quantity only), so the lot name generation checks for a tracked product instead. The _set_quantities_to_reservation override is removed: the method is not in the core in 18.0, 19.0 or 20.0 and nothing calls it. In the tests, stock.move takes uom_id and the receipt type comes from the warehouse.

The ruff 0.16.8 fixes of the 20.0 pre-commit are in a separate commit. The pylint missing-return check and the ruff useless return rule disagree on _compute_display_assign_serial, so the return is replaced by a pylint disable.

Also carries the two 19.0 changes of #2555 (auto lot from product categories, lot on print), adapted to 20.0: the category field sits on the Logistics page of the stock category form, and the lot on print check tests tracking the way the rest of the module does.

The module's 8 tests pass.

Tested on Odoo 20.0 Community (odoo/odoo at e264fed).

Migration of `stock_picking_auto_create_lot` from 19.0 to 20.0, following the [migration guide](https://github.com/OCA/maintainer-tools/wiki/Migration-to-version-20.0).

Changes required by the 20.0 framework:

- `product.template.tracking` no longer has a `none` value: it is now `False` on an untracked product, and the user-facing field is the new `store_by` (`untracked` / `quantity` / `lot` / `serial`). `_set_auto_lot` therefore tests `x.product_id.tracking` instead of `!= "none"`, and the product view uses `store_by not in ['lot', 'serial']`.
- The product view anchor `//div[field[@name='tracking']]` is gone. The field now goes inside the `traceability` group, which `stock.product_template_form_view_stock` adds, so the inherited view points there instead of `stock.view_template_property_form`. It lands in the Traceability block of the product's Inventory tab, next to the other lot settings.
- `stock.move._set_quantities_to_reservation()` no longer exists in 20.0, so the override of it was dropped: it could never be reached, and its `super()` call would raise. Its purpose was to avoid the backorder wizard opening after "set quantities to reserved", a flow 20.0 no longer has.
- `stock.move.product_uom` renamed to `uom_id` in the test fixture.

Housekeeping: manifest version, the pylint-odoo `missing-return` disable moved onto `_compute_display_assign_serial`, a specific exception instead of a bare `Exception` in the test helper (ruff TRY002), XML headers.

`display_assign_serial` / `_compute_display_assign_serial`, `stock.move.line.quantity_product_uom` and the `stock.lot.serial` sequence are unchanged on 20.0.

Checked on a clean 20.0 Community database: install, the 6 tests, and in the UI the "Auto Create Lot" checkbox on the operation type under Lots/Serial Numbers and on the product in the Traceability block, then a receipt of 3 units of a lot-tracked product validated with no lot prompt and no "Assign Serial Numbers" button, the detailed operations showing the lot 0000042 created from the sequence.

items.title: [IMP] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: add SKU-based lot/serial numbering
items.body:
Improves Stock Picking Auto Create Lot by adding per-product lot/serial generation options.

* Replaced the boolean with `auto_create_lot_option` (Odoo sequence / SKU based).
* Added Inventory setting “SKU Based Numbers Trailing” and applied it to SKU-based numbering.
* Implemented SKU-based lots/serials as `<SKU>-<N>` using an auto-managed per-product `ir.sequence`, with fallback to `stock.lot.serial` when SKU is missing.
* Added migration (bool -> selection), updated docs, and extended tests to keep codecov diff coverage.

items.title: [16.0][FIX] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: fix creating lot for 0 qty move lines for serial product
items.body:
Before this commit, when we use `stock_picking_auto_create_lot` for serial product with planned tansfer and set `quantity_done` that is less than demand, it will create lots record for all demand quantity and some records are quantity `0.00`.
Eg, our demand is `5` and `quantity_done` is `3`. It will create `5` stock lot records and `2` records are quantity `0.00`.
This commit is to address this issue.

@qrtl

items.title: [16.0][ADD] stock_picking_auto_create_lot_sequence
items.body:
This module acts as a bridge between the `stock_picking_auto_create_lot` and `product_lot_sequence` modules.
Due to the changes introduced in [this commit](https://github.com/OCA/stock-logistics-workflow/commit/1f1d1cd4ba102f35971c074ca869ed6f7113cd2b) for stock_picking_auto_create_lot, using these two modules together disrupts the design of `product_lot_sequence` by not allowing the use of specific sequences for each product. This module restores the intended behavior.
Related: https://github.com/OCA/stock-logistics-workflow/pull/1616
